description: Income tax and social contributions on an annual salary in one or more countries (OECD Taxing Wages method: single person, no children, full-year employee). Returns net pay, personal rate, tax wedge and marginal rate, sorted from lowest to highest personal rate. 21 countries are fully checked; some 130 more have preliminary data (marked level "preliminary"). For up to 3 countries also the line-by-line breakdown, special tax regimes for individuals (e.g. for newcomers), assumptions and official sources.

countries.description: ISO codes; default: the fully checked countries. Other codes in the list have preliminary data (salary tax scale and main contributions only).

gross_eur.description: Annual gross salary in EUR. Default 60,000 (reference profiles: 30,000 / 60,000 / 120,000).

gross_local.description: Annual gross salary in the country's own currency (only with exactly one country).

version.description: Language of the texts (version id). Default: en.

name: tax_burden
title: Tax burden on salary
